Saving for your first home? Two federal tools to know about. The First Home Savings Account (FHSA) has $8,000 of annual participation room, up to $40,000 in total, and unused room can carry forward (up to $8,000). The Home Buyers' Plan lets you withdraw up to $60,000 from your RRSP, repaid over 15 years.
